findings: Large single WSGI response chunks lose observable tail bytes with immediate connection finish in the tested runtime. HTTP/1.0 does not resolve it. Identical bytes split into 16 KiB WSGI chunks, or a diagnostic-only 100 ms finish delay, complete for all three native clients. No server connection_dropped event was observed; incomplete clients timeout or abort. This isolates a send/close-timing interaction but does not claim a packet-level Windows kernel root cause.
